text:
Priya: Need a crisp battlecard + simple inbound routing for the new inference story. Target: field and SDRs. Keep public piece very short, gate the routing playbook and pilot ask. Deadline: next Wed EOD.

Marco: Proposal: each competitor block = 30s pitch, 3 quick wins, 2 canned rebuttals. Also include one-line "migration signal" (what the buyer says that signals migration readiness).

Elise: I'll run a mini-benchmark and convert to a single chart: '99th-pct latency (p95 for embeddings), cost per 1M token-equivalent, and operational overhead (low/med/high)'. Will paste a draft chart tomorrow.

Dan: For cloud AI platforms note: fast onboarding, broad marketplace, but inconsistent tail latency and limited private deployment. Rebuttal: "We can match your existing integration speed but give you SLA-backed predictability and a migration path to private when you need it."

Priya: Good. For LLM API providers (pure SaaS APIs) highlight: simplest dev UX but no rollout control and limited routing. Rebuttal: "If you need control, Redwood provides the same API ergonomics plus can run in your VPC or dedicated fleet."

Marco: Infra vendors (self-hosted) block: full control and lowest marginal cost at scale but heavy ops and longer time-to-value. Rebuttal: "Avoid stitching and divergent toolchains; Redwood offers the same economics with productized rollout tooling and less ops debt."

Elise: Draft competitor snippets: 
- CloudVendorX: "Fastest path to prototype; variable tail latency; higher costs in bursty workloads."
- APICo: "Plug-and-play API; limited rollout & private options; opaque cost model at scale."
- InfraCorp: "Max control; large engineering lift; inconsistent support footprints across teams."

Priya: Routing play (SDR -> AE handoff):
1) Lead tags detected: "compliance", "on-prem", "low-latency", "high-qps", "cost-optimization"
2) If compliance/on-prem -> high-touch: AE + Solutions Eng + Security SE.
3) If low-latency/high-qps -> fast-track: prioritize for Dedicated pilot & priority scheduling.
4) If cost-optimization -> send Redwood Optimize calc + invite to webinar & gated battlecard.

Marco: Webinar tie-in: "From Prototype to Production: Predictable Inference at Scale". CTA: gated battlecard + pilot sign-up. Ask ops to wire an attribution tag so registrants get routed automatically.

ops-bot: Reminder: content-deadline set for 2026-04-22 16:00 UTC.

Elise: Uploaded chart and CSV: https://redwood.internal/bench/q2-2026-summary (internal). Chart includes sources + short methodology.

Dan: Two objection scripts for reps: 
- "Were on Cloud Y": "Cloud Y is great for quick dev cycles; Redwood is the production-grade layer that preserves velocity while giving SLAs, predictable unit costs, and a single API across hosted/dedicated/private."
- "We self-host already": "Nice. Do you have a unified rollout and tracing story across teams? Redwood standardizes the runtime and reduces duplicated ops work while keeping control."

Priya: Awesome. Marco, can you stitch the one-pager and gated playbook into PRD for Ops? Tag me when done.

Marco: Will do. Will post skeleton to #marketing-assets and ping AEs for quick feedback loop.

Priya: Thanks all. Keep public messaging tight: 1-line value prop, 3 bullets vs each competitor, and a CTA to a gated playbook.

ops-bot: Campaign-sync event scheduled for 2026-04-24 10:00 PT.
